verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators) take user-entered company data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI training is a fair privacy question. The pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or training-exclusion statement for these tools. The Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity page describes legal services Goodwin sells to clients, not its own handling of user data, so it does not count toward this story.
